repo_notes: VOD Tags detects Twitch live-stream highlights using multimodal ML (chat sentiment, PANNs audio tags, optical-flow movement) and a logistic regression metamodel. Preserve documentation for: (1) GCP default path (GCE + gsutil + public GCS), (2) local Docker Compose profile full, (3) web↔ML HTTP callbacks, (4) server/processor.py job pipeline and server/detector/ feature extractors.
